sample_space.shape: close-packed array of 19 vertical towers (13 floors x 4 crystals of 5x5x5 cm3) hanging from the 900 mm TSP inside the 940 mm MC vessel

diameter_or_width.location: TSP diameter from which detector hangs

sample_space.description: 988 TeO2 bolometer crystals, 5 x 5 x 5 cm3, 750 g each (742 kg total), in 19 copper-framed towers of 13 floors x 4 crystals, each crystal with an NTD thermistor and heater; operated at ~10 mK (8 mK base). Quote: 'CUORE is composed of 988 5 x 5 x 5 cm3 TeO2 crystals, each having a mass of 750 g' and 'The crystals are arranged into 19 copper-framed towers, with each tower consisting of 13 floors of 4 crystals' (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1710.07988). Tower height is not published in the sources checked.

wiring.from: 300 K IVC Wire Tray ports (5 DN40 readout + 1 DN40 heater)
wiring.quote: The detector wiring consists of woven ribbon cables with twisted pairs of NbTi wires in a NOMEX texture, for a total of ~2600 wires
3 DN16 ports for the readout of the DU sensors embedded in the DU

windows.quote: All the IVC ports are equipped with radiation baffles that prevent direct line of sight between the 300 K and the 4 K plates

moving_parts.rate: 1.4 Hz pressure wave (valve 0.7 rev/s), five PT415-RM, valves mounted remote from the cryostat
moving_parts.quote: This valve makes 0.7 revolutions per second ... results in pressure waves with a frequency that depends on the PT model and which is 1.4 Hz for the CUORE PTs

moving_parts.rate: five PT compressors ~15 m from the 300 K plate
moving_parts.quote: The compressors are located ~15 m away from the 300 K plate and are supported by a metallic structure connected to the concrete ground

moving_parts.rate: 3He/4He mixture circulation, up to >= 8 mmol/s with both condensing lines
moving_parts.quote: The maximum flow rate using both lines is >= 8 mmol s-1

moving_parts.rate: detector on Minus K isolators, 0.5 Hz cut-off; external lead on a movable platform
moving_parts.quote: This behavior favors very low natural frequencies for the spring-mass system, with a cut-off frequency of close to 0.5 Hz

notes: Six nested vessels: 300 K, 40 K, 4 K, Still (~0.8-0.9 K), HEX (~50 mK), MC (~10 mK). Vessel (shield) heights/diameters, Table II of arXiv:1904.05745: 300 K 1603x2620 mm; 40 K 1503x2765 mm; 4 K 1363x2471 mm; Still 1110x1850 mm; HEX 1020x1650 mm; MC 940x1365 mm. Inner Lead Shield (Roman lead, 1157 mm diam x 1568 mm, 60 mm thick, 3920 kg) between 4 K and Still; Top Lead (900 mm diam x 300 mm, 2110 kg) below MC plate above TSP. Cooling: five Cryomech PT415-RM (32 W at 45 K, 1.2 W at 4.2 K nominal each) on 40 K/4 K plates plus a custom dilution unit (~3-6 uW at 10 mK; 2 mW at 100 mK). 300 K plate suspended from a 4.7 m x 4.1 m steel I-beam Main Support Plate; total cold mass >15 t (LNGS page). Plate-to-plate distances Table I: 300K-40K 195 mm, 300K-4K 198 mm, 300K-Still 287 mm, Still-HEX 112 mm, HEX-MC 202 mm. Catalog file lists only the LNGS page; detailed numbers come from the collaboration's cryostat paper (Alduino et al., Cryogenics 2019, arXiv:1904.05745), first-results PRL (arXiv:1710.07988) and the PT noise-cancellation paper (arXiv:1712.02753).
